name: get_account_balance
description: Retrieve the current balance of a bank account

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the bank account

returns: Account balance with available balance, pending amount, and currency

name: get_transaction_history
description: Retrieve transaction history for a bank account

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the bank account

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return

returns: List of transactions with date, amount, description, category, and running balance

name: transfer_funds
description: Transfer money between accounts or to another person
returns: Transfer confirmation with transfer_id, amount, fees, and estimated arrival time

name: pay_bill
description: Pay a bill or make a payment to a payee
returns: Payment confirmation with payment_id, amount, scheduled date, and estimated arrival

name: get_stock_quote
description: Get the current stock price and basic market data for a ticker symbol
returns: Current price, daily change, volume, market cap, P/E ratio, and 52-week high/low

name: get_stock_history
description: Get historical price data for a stock over a time period
returns: Historical price data with open, high, low, close, volume for each interval

name: place_stock_order
description: Place a buy or sell order for a stock

limit_price.description: Limit price (for limit and stop_limit orders)

stop_price.description: Stop price (for stop and stop_limit orders)

returns: Order confirmation with order_id, status, estimated fill price, and commission

name: get_portfolio_summary
description: Get a summary of the user's investment portfolio
returns: Portfolio holdings, total value, allocation breakdown, and performance metrics

name: create_budget
description: Create a monthly budget with category-level spending limits

categories.description: Budget allocations by category (e.g., food: 500, transport: 200)

returns: Budget confirmation with category allocations and savings target

name: get_budget_status
description: Check current spending against budget for the month

account_ids.description: Account IDs to include in spending analysis

returns: Budget vs. actual spending by category with remaining amounts and alerts

name: get_spending_analysis
description: Analyze spending patterns over a period
returns: Spending breakdown with totals, averages, trends, and top merchants by category

name: get_credit_score
description: Retrieve the user's current credit score and key factors
returns: Credit score, score range, key positive/negative factors, and score history

name: compare_credit_cards
description: Compare credit card offers based on user criteria

annual_fee_max.description: Maximum annual fee willing to pay

returns: List of credit cards with APR, rewards, annual fee, sign-up bonus, and key benefits

name: set_savings_goal
description: Create a savings goal with target amount and timeline
returns: Savings goal created with recommended monthly contribution to meet target

name: get_savings_goals
description: Retrieve all savings goals and their current progress
returns: List of savings goals with target, current balance, progress percentage, and projected completion

name: calculate_loan_payment
description: Calculate monthly payment and total cost for a loan
returns: Monthly payment, total interest, total cost, and amortization schedule summary

name: get_tax_summary
description: Generate a tax summary for a specified tax year
returns: Tax summary with income, deductions, estimated tax liability, and relevant tax documents

name: search_etfs
description: Search for ETFs by criteria such as sector, expense ratio, or performance
returns: List of ETFs with symbol, name, expense ratio, AUM, performance, and holdings summary

name: get_exchange_rate
description: Get current foreign exchange rate between two currencies
returns: Exchange rate, converted amount, bid/ask spread, and 30-day rate trend

name: set_price_alert
description: Set a price alert for a stock or cryptocurrency
returns: Alert confirmation with alert_id and current price

name: get_financial_news
description: Get financial news articles optionally filtered by topic or stock

symbol.description: Stock symbol to get news for

returns: List of news articles with title, summary, source, date, and sentiment

name: calculate_investment_return
description: Calculate projected investment returns with compound interest

annual_return_rate.description: Expected annual return rate as percentage

inflation_rate.description: Expected annual inflation rate as percentage

returns: Projected portfolio value, total contributions, total returns, and inflation-adjusted value

name: list_recurring_payments
description: List all recurring payments and subscriptions linked to an account
returns: List of recurring payments with payee, amount, frequency, next payment date, and status

name: cancel_recurring_payment
description: Cancel a recurring payment or subscription

payment_id.description: ID of the recurring payment to cancel

returns: Cancellation confirmation with final payment date and any early termination fees

name: get_account_statements
description: Retrieve or download account statements for a period
returns: Account statement with all transactions, fees, interest, and ending balance

name: categorize_transaction
description: Assign or update the category of a specific transaction
returns: Updated transaction with new category assignment

name: get_mortgage_rates
description: Get current mortgage rates from multiple lenders
returns: List of mortgage rates from lenders with APR, monthly payment estimate, and fees

name: get_crypto_price
description: Get the current price and market data for a cryptocurrency
returns: Current price, 24h change, volume, market cap, and circulating supply

name: calculate_net_worth
description: Calculate total net worth across all linked accounts

include_accounts.description: Specific account IDs to include (all if empty)

returns: Net worth breakdown with total assets, total liabilities, and net worth trend over time

name: dispute_transaction
description: File a dispute for a suspicious or incorrect transaction

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction to dispute

supporting_docs.description: List of supporting document file paths

returns: Dispute case number, provisional credit amount, expected resolution timeline
